reference.title: Barbell Standing Twist
reference.listing: Video (title from the listing URL; the page could not be read from this environment, gymvisual.com is blocked by the proxy, so the movement is taken from the exercise name and standard coaching)

breathing.pattern: Breathe out as you turn, in as you come back to the middle.
breathing.cadence: About 1.2 s to each side, 1 s back

prescription.tempo: Smooth and controlled, no bouncing at the ends
prescription.load: An empty bar or a light bar: this is a control drill, not a strength lift.
prescription.progression: Add range slowly, then pause at the end of each turn; move to cable or band rotations for load.

cues.text: Bar across the upper back, hands just outside the shoulders, feet about shoulder width, knees soft, stand tall.
Turn the shoulders and the bar to the right; hips and knees stay facing forward.
Come back to the middle under control.
Turn to the left the same amount.
Back to the middle; stay tall and braced.

mistakes.fix: Turn slowly and stop each turn with the trunk muscles, not momentum.
Keep the belt buckle facing forward; the turn comes from above the pelvis.
Keep the bar level and the trunk tall.
Light bar only; the long lever loads the spine at the end range.

kinematics.norm: Thoracic and lumbar rotation; the lumbar spine contributes only a few degrees (clinical opinion). Repeated loaded end-range twisting stresses the discs (Marshall and McGill 2010)
High bar on the upper traps, hands just outside the shoulders (clinical opinion)

cautions: Use a light bar and a smooth, moderate range; avoid fast or bouncing twists.
Back pain or a disc history: choose anti-rotation work (Pallof press) instead.
Clear the space around you: the bar ends travel far.
Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Seated on a bench to lock the hips.
progressions: Pause at the end of each turn.

muscleNotes.obliques_r: Turn the rib cage over a still pelvis and stop the turn at each end.
muscleNotes.obliques_l: Turn the rib cage over a still pelvis and stop the turn at each end.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Keep the trunk tall; the deep back muscles also help rotate.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Keep the trunk tall; the deep back muscles also help rotate.
muscleNotes.glute_med_r: Holds the pelvis level and facing forward.
muscleNotes.glute_med_l: Holds the pelvis level and facing forward.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Hold the bar on the shoulders.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Hold the bar on the shoulders.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_r: Keep the shoulder blades squeezed under the bar.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_l: Keep the shoulder blades squeezed under the bar.
